text:
Vitali Pinchuk took the long road to Nashville. Never drafted, he scored 66 points in 65 KHL games for Dinamo Minsk last season, roughly 60 over 82 NHL games by our league translation, and he's now 11 games into his NHL career. The first goal came on Nov 5 against Colorado, a night Sports Illustrated headlined "First NHL Goal, First NHL Blood, Vitali Pinchuk Drives Predators to Victory". Nashville has kept winning since.

What we like is where his shots come from. In under 9 minutes a night he has 2.11 expected goals (the quality of his chances), 1.29 per 60 minutes, a strong rate for a depth forward, against 1 goal. His shot is one of the softer ones in the league by NHL Edge (10th percentile for speed), so the chances are coming from getting to good ice, not from distance. The five-on-five share is less flattering: Nashville has had 42.1% of the expected goals with him on, about 6 points worse than without him. Eleven games is a small sample, and our season range for him is wide, 11 to 28 points. The thing to watch is whether his minutes grow.
headline: Pinchuk's chances are ahead of his goals
